title: 第794章 原来是表妹第793章 路遇李雪婷
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
沈算听出了她的言外之意，却懒得解释。
他点头道：“算是吧。”
语气随意，漫不经心。
然这随意的态度，反而让李雪婷更加确信了自己的猜测。
她发出邀请：“表哥，要不要一起去云雾湖踏青？今日秋高气爽，云雾湖景色正好，正是踏青的好时节。”
“表妹先……”沈算刚要婉拒，话未出口，便被一道轻柔之声从远方天空中传来打断。
“世兄——小妹可算是找到你了。”那声音温婉如水，却清晰得仿佛就在耳边。
众人循声望去，只见远方天际，一头背生双翼、通体七彩斑斓的鹿异种正飞驰而来。
那鹿身形修长，鹿角如珊瑚，皮毛在阳光下泛着七彩流光，双翼舒展，每一次扇动都带起一阵清风，吹散周围的云朵。
鹿背上，坐着一位青莲裙、蒙面纱的女子。
长裙在风中舞动，与她那乌黑如瀑的长发交织在一起，飘逸出尘。
裙摆之下，没有白花花的大长腿，却是一双被白素紧身裤包裹的修长美腿，线条流畅，若隐若现，反而更添几分神秘与诱惑。
当沈算看清来人时，不由下意识地刮了刮自己高挺的鼻梁——那是一个略显无奈的小动作。
钟源则是面露古怪，在李雪婷和来人之间左看右看，心中暗忖：这是什么情况？一个表妹还没打发走，又来一个？少爷这桃花运，来得未免也太密集了些。
冯六则是一个劲儿地挠头，似有什么想不通。
他看看李雪婷，又看看天上的女子，又看看自家少爷，脸上的表情逐渐从困惑变成恍然，又从恍然变成羡慕——少爷不愧是少爷，连出门闲逛都能遇到两个绝世美女。
而那一群青年才俊则快速地低下了头，不敢与那来人直视。
那魔鬼般的身材，那温婉中带着几分清冷的气质，那双仿佛会说话的秋眸——看一眼便心神摇曳，再看一眼便心跳如鼓，再看下去怕是连马都骑不稳了。
李雪婷倒是没有顾忌。
她抬起一双清冷的眸子，直直注视着与自己同样蒙着面纱、同样遮掩不住的婀娜多姿、同样温婉气质的来女。

目光中带着几分审视，几分好奇，还有几分说不清道不明的意味。
七彩鹿速度极快，转瞬间便从远处飞至众人头顶。
临近众骑时，它双翼一收，身形迎风缩小，从数丈翼展缩至寻常马匹大小，轻盈落地，四蹄踏在草地上，不掀起半点尘埃。
“世兄，好久不见。”来女看向沈算，温婉出声。
声音轻柔如风，却带着难以掩饰的欣喜。
“确实好久不见。”沈算望着她，嘴角不自觉地上扬，“慧怡更甚往昔，凡尘不染，犹如天女仙临。”
他说得文绉绉的，一副“舔狗”模样，钟源听了都忍不住嘴角一抽。
“呵呵。”文慧怡轻笑出声，眼波流转，“世兄也是一如既往的文采飞扬，俊朗更甚。”
她顿了顿，目光从沈算身上移开，扫过李雪婷，又收回，轻声问道，“世兄这是……在陪佳人踏青？”
“啊？不是。”沈算连忙否认，“偶遇，偶遇。”
李雪婷看着两人旁若无人的对话，尤其是沈算那副急于撇清关系的样子，心中不由得生出一丝异样。
content_en:
Shen Suan heard the implication of her words, but was too lazy to explain.
He nodded and said: "That's right."
The tone is casual and nonchalant.
However, this casual attitude made Li Xueting more convinced of her guess.
She extended an invitation: "Cousin, do you want to go for an outing to Yunwu Lake together? Today is a refreshing autumn day, and the scenery of Yunwu Lake is just right. It is a good time for an outing."
"Cousin first..." Shen Suan was about to decline, but before he could speak, he was interrupted by a soft voice from the distant sky.
"Brother, my little sister has finally found you." The voice was as gentle as water, but as clear as if it was in my ears.
Everyone followed the sound and saw in the distant sky, a deer mutant with two wings on its back and a colorful body flying towards it.
The deer has a slender body, antlers like coral, and its fur glows with colorful lights in the sun. Its wings are stretched out, and every time it flaps, it brings up a gust of breeze and disperses the surrounding clouds.
On the back of the deer sits a woman in a green lotus skirt and veil.
The long skirt danced in the wind, intertwined with her long black hair, flowing elegantly.
Under the skirt, there are no long white legs, but a pair of slender legs wrapped in white tights. The lines are smooth and looming, which adds a bit of mystery and temptation.
When Shen Suan saw the person coming clearly, he couldn't help but subconsciously scratch the bridge of his nose - a slightly helpless little gesture.
Zhong Yuan looked strange, looking left and right between Li Xueting and the visitor, thinking to himself: What is going on? One cousin hasn't been sent away yet, and another one comes? The young master's luck has come too intensively.
Feng Liu kept scratching his head, as if he couldn't figure out something.
He looked at Li Xueting, then at the woman in the sky, and then at his young master. The expression on his face gradually changed from confusion to surprise, and then from surprise to envy - the young master is indeed a young master, and he can meet two peerless beauties even when he goes out for a stroll.
The group of young talents quickly lowered their heads, not daring to look directly at the person.
That devilish figure, that gentle yet cold temperament, those autumn eyes that seemed to be able to speak - one glance would make your heart sway, another glance would make your heart beat like a drum, and if you continue to look at it, you might even be unable to ride a horse.
Li Xueting had no scruples.
She raised a pair of cold eyes and stared directly at the girl who was also veiled and could not be concealed, and who was also graceful and graceful, with the same gentle temperament.
There was a bit of scrutiny, a bit of curiosity, and a bit of unexplainable meaning in his eyes.
The colorful deer was extremely fast and flew from a distance to the top of everyone's heads in an instant.
When it approached the other riders, it retracted its wings and shrank in the wind, shrinking from a wingspan of several feet to the size of an ordinary horse. It landed lightly on the ground, its four hooves stepping on the grass without raising any dust.
"Brother, long time no see." The girl looked at Shen Suan and spoke gently.
The voice was as soft as the wind, but it was filled with joy that could not be concealed.
"It's been a long time indeed." Shen Suan looked at her, with the corners of his mouth raised unconsciously, "Hui Yi is even worse than before, spotless, like a goddess coming from heaven."
He spoke in a refined manner, with a "dog-licking" look, and Zhong Yuan couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth after hearing this.
"Haha." Wen Huiyi chuckled, her eyes moving, "Brother Shi is as literary and talented as ever, and even more handsome."
She paused, looked away from Shen Suan, glanced at Li Xueting, then looked back, and asked softly, "Brother, are you... on an outing with a beautiful lady?"
"Ah? No." Shen Suan quickly denied, "A chance encounter, a chance encounter."
Li Xueting looked at the conversation between the two of them as if no one was watching, especially Shen Suan's eagerness to clear up the relationship, and she couldn't help but feel a little strange in her heart.
